reserveReview.rationale: Fixed-block remeasurement on 2026-09-04. Issuer docs and UsdtDepositManager source confirm dual routes: users lock USDT on Optimism or USDC on Base; each DepositManager supplies the deposit token into Aave V3 and mints JPYT. Public RPC reads at Optimism block 156472176 returned aOptUSDT (0x6ab707aca953edaefbc4fd23ba73294241490620).balanceOf(0x77c1e40f5e7bb19c34d81f986fb13fe655f23cd9) = 44,616.509375 USDT; Base block 50876890 returned aBasUSDC (0x4e65fe4dba92790696d040ac24aa414708f5c0ab).balanceOf(0x0eab9d66adb8527cd7c0e7e7c1782580431ec276) = 6,248.278544 USDC. Combined aToken reserves = 50,864.787919 USD, giving 87.715906% USDT and 12.284094% USDC. Residual unknowns: Aave utilization-driven withdrawal latency and legal custody terms beyond on-chain smart-contract custody.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: On-chain aToken balances of DePhaser DepositManager proxies plus issuer money-flow docs
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Legal segregation/bankruptcy-remoteness of Aave positions and instantaneous redeemable liquidity under high Aave utilization are not published as static legal terms; weights themselves are measured.
